candidates.title: Prepare school invoice fields for review

demandEvidence.chore: Handle invoices and prepare economic records for budget follow-up.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: hantera fakturor och ta fram ekonomiska underlag för budget och uppföljning

ease.reason: A beginner can mock one invoice-field extraction from fictional files; the n8n template documents extraction and sheet logging, not school-specific rules.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school office might value less repetitive invoice entry; this paid role does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week test can extract operator-chosen fields from synthetic PDFs and log drafts as the template describes; school coding and live access remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable extract-and-log draft is documented, but staff must verify every field and decide coding, approval and payment.

evidence.reason: The notice names invoice handling and economic records; templates show invoice extraction/logging, but neither establishes school use, frequency or AI buyers.

candidates.reason: A narrow synthetic invoice-field draft is supported by a fresh school-administration notice and two invoice workflow listings, but the equally weighted mean is 5.4, below the threshold of 6; school-specific rules and real deployment access are unproved.
